tools.name: readgzh_read
tools.title: Read WeChat article
tools.description: Read the full text of a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) article from its mp.weixin.qq.com URL. Returns title, author, publish time and clean Markdown content. Cached articles are free; a fresh extraction costs 3 credits from the signed-in user's ReadGZH balance.

url.description: Full WeChat article URL, e.g. https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/xxxx

tools.name: readgzh_search
tools.title: Search cached articles
tools.description: Search WeChat articles already cached by ReadGZH, by keyword in title or content (Chinese or English). Returns matching titles and slugs; read one with readgzh_get.

tools.name: readgzh_list
tools.title: List recent cached articles
tools.description: List the most recently cached WeChat articles on ReadGZH, newest first. Useful for browsing.

limit.description: Number of articles, default 10, capped at 50

tools.name: readgzh_list_by_account
tools.title: List cached articles by account
tools.description: List cached WeChat articles from one Official Account (公众号), newest first. Only covers articles already cached by ReadGZH — WeChat has no public archive API, so the result is never exhaustive; say so when presenting it.

account.description: Official Account name (author); partial match supported

limit.description: Number of articles, default 10, capped at 50

tools.name: readgzh_get
tools.title: Get cached article by slug
tools.description: Read a cached WeChat article by its ReadGZH slug. Long articles are chunked at ~40,000 characters; pass part to page through them. Always free — no credits.

slug.description: Article slug, e.g. the value after /s/ in a ReadGZH link

part.description: Chunk number starting at 1 for long articles
